---
name: "nf-core/bcl_demultiplex"
description: "Demultiplex Illumina BCL data using bcl-convert or bcl2fastq"
keywords:
- "bcl"
- "bclconvert"
- "bcl2fastq"
- "demultiplex"
- "fastq"
components:
- "bcl2fastq"
- "bclconvert"
- "multiqcsav"
input:
- ch_flowcell:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing the Illumina SampleSheet CSV describing the samples\
      \ to be\ndemultiplexed, together with the directory or tar archive holding the\
      \ Illumina\nBCL data (the sequencer output directory). The meta map carries\
      \ the flowcell\nidentifier and lane, e.g. [ id:'string', lane: int ].\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(samplesheet), path(flowcell) ]\n"
- demultiplexer:
    type: "string"
    description: "Which demultiplexer to use, bcl2fastq or bclconvert"
output:
- fastq:
    type: "file"
    description: "Demultiplexed FASTQ files, with read group information added to\
      \ the meta map.\nSamples whose FASTQ files are empty are routed to `empty_fastq`\
      \ instead.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(fastq) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fastq.gz"
- empty_fastq:
    type: "file"
    description: "Demultiplexed FASTQ files that contain no reads, separated out so\
      \ that\ndownstream processes do not have to handle them.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ [ path(fastq) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fastq.gz"
- reports:
    type: "file"
    description: "Demultiplexing reports.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(reports)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "Reports/*"
- stats:
    type: "file"
    description: "Demultiplexing statistics (bcl2fastq only).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(stats) ]\n"
    pattern: "Stats/*"
- interop:
    type: "file"
    description: "InterOp files.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(interop) ]\n"
    pattern: "InterOp/*"
- logs:
    type: "file"
    description: "Demultiplexing logs (bclconvert only).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(logs) ]\n"
    pattern: "Logs/*"
- undetermined:
    type: "file"
    description: "FASTQ files holding the reads that could not be assigned to any\
      \ sample.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(fastq) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "Undetermined_S0*_R?_00?.fastq.gz"
- sav_report:
    type: "file"
    description: "MultiQC report summarising the sequencing analysis viewer (SAV)\
      \ metrics for\nthe flowcell.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(html) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.html"
- sav_data:
    type: "directory"
    description: "MultiQC data directory for the SAV report.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(data) ]\n"
    pattern: "*_data"
- sav_plots:
    type: "file"
    description: "Plots created by MultiQC for the SAV report.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(plots) ]\n"
    pattern: "*_plots"
- autodetect_samplesheet:
    type: "file"
    description: "Revised sample sheet written by bcl-convert in autodetect mode\n\
      (`--bcl-output-format demux-autodetect`, bclconvert only). No FASTQ files\n\
      are produced in this mode.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(csv) ]\n"
    pattern: "SampleSheet.autodetect.csv"
authors:
- "@matthdsm"
maintainers:
- "@matthdsm"
version: "0.0.0-a7c6519"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/bclconvert@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/bcl2fastq@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/multiqcsav@0.0.0-1b655c6"
